description: Find the bullet points in one of the user's CVs that list duties instead of results, with the weak phrases flagged, so they can be rewritten with numbers and outcomes. Free, no AI. Use when the user wants stronger, quantified achievements.

cvId.description: The id of the CV to use (get it from list_my_takemeup_cvs).

locale.description: Language for results and links (en, de, fr, …). Defaults to the language of the user's TakeMeUp account.

name: find_takemeup_weak_achievements
title: Achievement amplifier (free)
